metadata.author: Onassis Foundation
metadata.description: A dramatic adventure for tweens and listeners of all ages, Live from Mount Olympus, produced by the Onassis Foundation, weaves timeless Greek myths with the artistry of today’s foremost theater-makers and the imaginative power of audio. Hermes, god of storytellers, travelers, and thieves (Tony Award-winner André De Shields), is the godpod’s host.
